text:
jordan: Hey team! pre-start today — Okta shows me as 'Provisioned' but I can't access the eng-drive or get a gsuite mailbox. Anyone know if Scoped Group sync is delayed? @mira

mira: @jordan welcome! :wave: I don't see your GSuite account yet either. People Ops usually triggers provisioning; tagging IT.

mike-it: Hi Jordan, can you paste the email you were invited with? Also what's the email you used to sign up?

jordan: jordan.k@redwood-inference.com

mike-it: Thanks. Checking... Looks like your Okta account exists but not in group 'eng-all' — scoped group sync failed earlier. Workaround: I can add you to eng-write now for Drive. Do you need write access?

jordan: Yes write access would be great. Trying to clone repos next.

mike-it: OK adding now. Also can you try signing into gmail web (mail.google.com) and report the error? If it says 'account not found' that'll clear once sync finishes but I'm forcing group assignment.

jordan: Got 'No account matches this login'

it-bot: [system] Provisioning queue note: group-sync job 2026-03-23T09:12Z had transient 502 to identity API, retrying.

mira: @mike-it do you want me to escalate to vendor SSO if it keeps failing after 10m?

mike-it: If it still says no account in 15 minutes ping me here and I'll run a manual import and open a ticket.

jordan: Drive access works now :tada: I can see eng folder and created a test doc. Gmail still shows 'no account' though.

mike-it: Gmail sometimes lags a bit — let's wait 10 minutes. Meanwhile here's the Okta verify page if you haven't enrolled MFA: https://okta.redwood.example/setup

mike-it: If you need SSH access to the monorepo, do this locally:

```
ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -C "jordan.k@redwood-inference.com"
cat ~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub
```

Then paste the public key into the 1Password onboarding item "SSH Keys - onboarding" and ping @devops.

jordan: MFA enroller page redirected earlier but I retried and it's up. Generating SSH key now.

mira: Welcome aboard again! If anything else blocks your first-day checklist ping me and I'll triage with infra. Also, quick intro: your onboarding buddy is @ashley.

jordan: thanks everyone! :pray:
